summary.zh: 安全加固与会话续期：凭据加密存储，令牌过期自动刷新，升级不再丢登录
summary.en: Security hardening + session renewal: encrypted credentials, auto token refresh, upgrades keep your login

items.zh: 新增登录令牌自动续期，过期不再掉登录
items.en: Auto-renew expiring OAuth tokens so sessions survive

items.zh: 修复登录令牌明文保存的问题，改为系统密钥库加密存储
items.en: Encrypt account tokens with Android Keystore

items.zh: 修复自定义登录密钥明文保存的问题，旧数据自动迁移
items.en: Encrypt custom OAuth client secret, migrate legacy data

items.zh: 修复下载镜像误判导致自动登出
items.en: Mirror 401s no longer sign you out

items.zh: 修复后台轮询失败误删已存账号
items.en: Background 401 no longer deletes stored accounts

items.zh: 修复升级安装后登录记录被清空
items.en: App updates no longer wipe saved logins

items.zh: 修复已登录时添加第二个账号失败
items.en: Fix adding a second account while signed in

items.zh: 登出改为停用账号，重登自动恢复
items.en: Sign-out now deactivates instead of deleting

items.zh: 应用签名密钥移出代码仓库，改由 CI 安全通道注入
items.en: Move the APK signing key out of the repo into CI secrets

items.zh: 云备份与设备迁移不再携带任何登录凭据
items.en: Keep credentials out of cloud backups and device transfers
